title: PotatoCannon
description: Weaponize your farm! A fun and balanced Potato Cannon mod featuring 3D models and 4 unique ammo types including explosive, poisonous, and sniper rounds.
body:
🥔 Potato Cannon Mod
Weaponize your garden!

Tired of throwing away Poisonous Potatoes? Bored of the standard Bow and Crossbow? The Potato Cannon Mod introduces a high-quality, 3D-modeled launcher that turns your farm produce into heavy artillery. It fits perfectly into the vanilla style while adding a fun, explosive twist to combat.

✨ Features
Custom 3D Model: A realistic, "bazooka-style" launcher that looks great in first and third-person views.

4 Unique Ammo Types: Each vegetable has a different effect, damage, and particle style.

Balanced Gameplay: Features a cooldown system and durability, making it a fair weapon for Survival.

Custom Sounds & Particles: Satisfying "thump" sounds and smoke trails.

Advancements: Unlock the "Spud Gunner" advancement upon crafting.

🥕 Ammunition Types
The cannon automatically detects what's in your inventory. The priority order is:

Golden Carrot (The Sniper) 🎯

Effect: High velocity, massive damage (3.5 hearts), and almost no gravity drop.

Visual: Leaves a sparkling trail.

Best for: Long-range precision shots.

Baked Potato (The Incendiary) 🔥

Effect: Sets enemies on fire for 3 seconds.

Visual: Emits a smoke trail while flying.

Best for: Dealing damage over time.

Poisonous Potato (The Bio-Weapon) ☠️

Effect: Low impact damage but inflicts Poison for 4 seconds.

Best for: Weakening enemies or PvP annoyance. Finally, a use for poisonous potatoes!

Regular Potato (The Standard) 🥔

Effect: Standard impact damage (1 heart). Cheap and reliable.

Best for: General combat and mob farming.

🛠️ Crafting Recipe
Crafting the Potato Cannon is simple but requires some iron engineering.

Top Row: 3x Iron Ingots (Barrel)

Middle Row: Flint & Steel (Igniter) + Iron Ingot

Bottom Row: Log (Handle)


📦 Installation
Download and install Fabric Loader.

Download the Fabric API and put it in your mods folder.

Download the Potato Cannon Mod and put it in your mods folder.

Launch the game and start blasting!
